files.code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

# Build the admin and ship it next to the Go binary.
pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
pnpm -F @duxweb/lumi-admin-demo build
cp -r apps/admin/dist ./server/public
echo "Built $(date +%F) for ${ENVIRONMENT:-staging}"

files.title: orders.sql
files.code:
-- Paid orders from the last four weeks, newest first.
SELECT o.id, o.number, c.name AS customer, o.total
FROM orders AS o
JOIN customers AS c ON c.id = o.customer_id
WHERE o.status = 'paid'
  AND o.created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '28 days'
ORDER BY o.created_at DESC
LIMIT 20;
